definitions.explanation: Something that seems wrong, unusual, or not quite right. Often implies suspicion that something is amiss.
Something that makes you laugh or smile. Used when something is humorous or comical.

notes:
おかしい has two main meanings: 'strange/wrong' and 'funny/amusing.' Context determines which sense is intended.

SENSE DISTINCTION:
- Strange: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧おかしい (something is off/wrong)
- Funny: おかしい⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (a funny story)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: おかしく (おかしく⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ — to find something strange)
- Te-form: おかしくて (⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦くらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧おかしくて — so funny I couldn't stop laughing)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧おかしい: something is wrong/off
- おかしい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧: to think something is strange
- おかしな + noun: strange/funny (prenominal form, note: おかしな not おかしい)

WRITING:
Can be written {可笑|おか}しい in kanji, but hiragana is far more common.

NOTE: The prenominal form おかしな (before nouns) is irregular — it follows な-adjective pattern despite being an い-adjective.
